retrievalProfile.description: A warm, earthy 1970s-style portrait layout featuring a central framed photograph within a wide tan border and distinctive rounded geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square-ish photograph of a couple in a soft-focus outdoor setting, framed by a thick, uniform tan or kraft-paper colored border. The typography is placed at the top of the border, utilizing a heavy, rounded geometric sans-serif that echoes the 1970s aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photograph framed by a wide, solid-color margin
Typography aligned to the top corners of the border
Color harmony between the tan border and the brown/green tones of the image
Soft, natural lighting in the subject matter contrasting with the flat graphic border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are centered within the inner frame, occupying approximately 70% of the photographic area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central embrace of the couple serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, move across to the top-right text, then drop into the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The wide outer border acts as significant negative space, focusing attention on the central image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with warm, mid-range values to create a nostalgic, sun-faded look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with heavy weight and circular curves
letterConstructionRules: Pronounced rounded corners on all terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' has a wide, symmetrical fork
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title to maintain graphic consistency.
graphicDevices: Thin black keyline around the photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s geometric rounded aesthetic perfectly.
Classic 70s font with the correct weight and rounded geometry.
Similar geometric structure and rounded feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s-style outdoor portrait of a couple in earth-toned clothing, placed inside a square frame with a thin black border, all centered on a wide tan/beige solid background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a heavy rounded geometric sans-serif in dark brown at the top left and top right of the tan border.

verificationChecks: Is the border color a warm tan/beige?
Is the font heavily rounded and geometric?
Is the photograph's color palette muted and warm?
Is there a clear separation between the text and the image?

adjustableVariables: Subject matter of the central photo
Specific placement of text within the top margin
mustRedesign: Do not use high-contrast black and white

mustAchieve: Balanced framing with the wide border
avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Verify the tan border is uniform in color
Confirm the image has a soft, nostalgic feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Wide Earth-Tone Border + Central Soft-Focus Portrait + Rounded Geometric Display Type = 70s Folk Aesthetic
